messages.author: aa76bc9ea2907e22
messages.subject: only colour tip branches
parts:
Hi,

I have been using groupOTU to color the branches on a tree base on IUCN red list status, but it does not make sense to colour the internal branches of the tree, which happens with groupOTU.

is there a method to just color the branches that are associated with tips?

When using APE for this I would do the following

# make a vector of color for all edges in the tree
edge.col <- rep("black", dim(tree$edge)[1])
# get the edge index for each branch under a tip - taken from BioGeoBears Package
tip.branches <- get_indices_of_branches_under_tips(tree)
# substitute tip branch colors in edge.col with a vector of color for tips that are order by tree$tip.label
edge.col[tip.branches] <- tip.colours

# plot with edge.color = edge.col
plot(tree, type = "fan", show.tip.label = F, edge.color = edge.col)


Might there be away to alter groupOTU to specify whether only tip branch or internal branches are to be colored?


Thanks!

ggtree is an awesome packages and keeps getting better!


Pete

messages.author: aa76bc9ea2907e22
messages.subject: Re: only colour tip branches
parts:
Actually i think i figured it out! using the %<+% pipe to add a data frame the first listed the colors of the tips, then black for all the internal edges.

the length of the color column in the data.frame should equal Nnode(tree)+length(tree$tip.label)

d <- data.frame(node=1:(Nnode(tree)+length(tree$tip.label)), color = c(tip.colours, rep("black", Nnode(aves))))

ggtree(tree) %<+% d + aes(color=I(color))
